premise.claim: GenerateOwnerReferenceFromObject recovers the GroupVersionKind from the scheme only when Kind or Version is empty, so an object carrying a group-less apiVersion (e.g. TypeMeta{Kind: "Dataset", APIVersion: "v1alpha1"}) yields an OwnerReference with apiVersion "v1alpha1", which the Kubernetes garbage collector and the controller's owner-based watch cannot resolve (issue #6205).
premise.evidence: results/base-run.txt: on base e4a10bf, TestOwnerRefGroupRecoveryGrouplessAPIVersionWithKind fails with APIVersion = "v1alpha1", want "data.fluid.io/v1alpha1" (same for the consumer path, results/base-consumer-run.txt)
